name: Jezreel (City in the Jezreel Valley where King Jehoram lay sick, known as the city of Jezreel in the territory of the tribe of Issachar)
title: Royal City in the Jezreel Valley
summary: Jezreel was an important city in the territory of the tribe of Issachar, located in the fertile Jezreel Valley. The city became known as a royal residence for the kings of Israel, especially King Ahab and his house. Many dramatic events took place here, including Naboth's vineyard, King Jehoram's sickbed, and Jehu's bloody takeover.

keyEvents.title: Assigned to the Tribe of Issachar
keyEvents.description: Jezreel was assigned as a city within the territory of the tribe of Issachar during the land distribution under Joshua.

keyEvents.title: Naboth's Vineyard
keyEvents.description: King Ahab coveted Naboth's vineyard in Jezreel. Queen Jezebel conspired to have Naboth killed so that Ahab could take the vineyard, which led to God's judgment against Ahab's house.

keyEvents.title: Elijah's Judgment Against Ahab's House
keyEvents.description: The prophet Elijah proclaimed God's judgment against Ahab and Jezebel in Jezreel because of the murder of Naboth and the theft of his vineyard.

keyEvents.title: King Joram lies sick in Jezreel
keyEvents.description: King Joram of Israel went to Jezreel to be healed after being wounded in battle against the Arameans at Ramoth in Gilead. King Ahaziah of Judah came to visit him there.

keyEvents.title: Jehu's coup d'état in Jezreel
keyEvents.description: Jehu rode to Jezreel and killed King Joram, who was thrown onto Naboth's field in fulfillment of Elijah's prophecy. King Ahaziah of Judah was also killed.

keyEvents.title: Jezebel's death in Jezreel
keyEvents.description: Queen Jezebel was thrown out of the window in Jezreel on Jehu's orders and eaten by dogs, as prophesied by Elijah.

keyEvents.title: Hosea's prophecy about Jezreel
keyEvents.description: The prophet Hosea named his son Jezreel as a prophetic sign, for God would punish the house of Jehu for the bloodshed in Jezreel and bring an end to the kingdom of Israel.
